_comment: Per-model LLM price rows for the harness budget (red-team B6). Values are LIST USD per 1M tokens; the harness
charges ceiling = list x ceiling_multiplier. Output price applies to candidates + thinking tokens.
A call to a model with no row here is REFUSED (fail closed) and invalidates the run (unpriced_model).
verified=false: the row is from the harness author's knowledge, not checked against current Vertex pricing.
Live/record modes refuse to start while any row used by the configured cascade is unverified, unless
and flip verified=true (or correct the numbers).

gemini-3.8-flash.note: assumed (no published price known to author); conservative Flash-class guess

gemini-3.7-flash.note: assumed (no published price known to author); conservative Flash-class guess

gemini-4-argon.note: third-party source (owner 10-14 task): intro $2/$10 per M in/out to 2026-11-30, $4/$20 from 2026-12-01 (cached $0.10 -> $0.20). The harness has no dated rows, so the row carries the higher (2026-12-01) list price: the budget ceiling stays an upper bound on both sides of the switch. 32768 = non-streaming output cap (no long decode).

gemini-4-carbon.note: Cloud Billing Catalog, Vertex AI, global online, effective 2026-11-10 (SKUs C47F-BE66-1A4E input, 1B77-85A0-B300 output; cached input $0.20). A launch discount, if any, is applied as credits and is not in the catalog. 32768 = the non-streaming output cap the platform uses for Carbon (Argon's; Carbon's own cap not measured).
